workload: 512 requests, each with 1,024 input and 256 output tokens, arriving at 128 requests per second

buckets.name: GPU idle time
buckets.description: Time the run holds the GPU without modeled GPU work.

buckets.name: Load imbalance
buckets.description: The modeled gap between completion limited by stragglers and balanced work.

buckets.name: Batching gap
buckets.description: The modeled gap between the observed batches and best profiled kernel throughput with batching unconstrained.

buckets.name: Communication
buckets.description: The modeled cost removed when communication operations are excluded. This single-GPU run has none.

buckets.name: Kernel efficiency gap
buckets.description: The difference between profiled best kernel rates and the matching hardware peak.

buckets.name: Redundant work gap
buckets.description: The gap between the executed operations at hardware peak and the separate model-required operation bounds.

buckets.name: Fusion gap
buckets.description: The difference between separate operation lower bounds and the scope-fused lower bound. This is theoretical headroom, not a measured fusion speedup.

buckets.name: Model-required lower bound
buckets.description: The scope-fused theoretical bound derived from model FLOPs and bytes at hardware peak rates.

note: Simulated GPU-seconds, not measured end-to-end hardware results. Buckets sum to the simulated total. This unlocked analysis permits idealized rebatching and uses segmented and scope-fused model-work lower bounds; the gaps are not guaranteed achievable savings.
